rows.22:9094:

rows.22:98f4:

rows.22:99b8:

rows.22:9c38:
The exam period finally ended, and it was break time.

rows.22:9eb0:

rows.22:9f50:

It looked like a perfectly ordinary restroom.
I worked up my nerve, went inside, and decided to look for Nakano.
I stepped in, but no invisible hands grabbed me like before.

Unless someone's hiding in a stall or in the cleaning closet, you can see the whole place from the entrance.
I went around peeking into the stalls, one by one.
And finally, it was time to look in the last stall.
It was the one closest to the hallway, a dark, damp stall.{p}
rows.22:a178:

I went over and picked it up: it was a button off a school uniform.
I couldn't tell which school it was from, but I could tell it wasn't from this high school's uniform, at least.
"Ah!"
In a flash, it came to me.
That it might be a button that had fallen off Nakano's uniform.
There was nothing to back that up, but I was sure this had to be Nakano's button.
"Nakano..."
The moment I murmured that...{p}
rows.22:a35c:

I'd stepped into the stall to pick up the button.
In other words, I was locked in.
rows.22:a3e8:
Startled, I tried to open the door, but it wouldn't budge an inch.
I remembered the terror from before.
rows.22:a470:
Half in tears, I kept throwing myself against the door.
"Help! Somebody help meeee!"
Shouting for help as loud as I could.

I was scared.
It wasn't like anything had appeared, but the door of a restroom where nobody but me should have been had shut by itself and wouldn't open.
rows.22:a5d4:

Sobbing and screaming, I kept pounding on the door with my fists.
Even so, nobody came, and the door didn't open.
While I was doing that, I felt like I could hear something mixed in with the pounding.
I stopped pounding on the door and listened closely.
...I couldn't hear a thing.
But even though my ears couldn't hear it, I was sure I could hear something.
It felt like it was coming from the door.
I got scared to be near the door, so I pressed myself against the back wall to get as far from it as I could, and stared at the door.

You know how restroom doors are always covered in graffiti, right?
Dirty drawings, or
"Love you, So-and-so! From Such-and-such, Class 2-B"
and messages like that.
At first I figured it was more of that and didn't pay it any mind, but then I noticed one piece of graffiti that said something different.

I was dragged in here and died.

Hosoda.
I'm going to curse you.
I'll curse you.
I won't kill you quickly.
I'll kill you slowly...
You can't escape.
No, I will never let you escape.
You can't leave this school.
When you graduate from here, you will di..."

rows.22:ac64:

"See, there's a bruise shaped like hands on my neck, isn't there..."

Hosoda's face suddenly turned bright red, and then went pale.
Beads of sweat were pouring from his whole body.{p}
rows.22:af1c:
"Hosoda!"

His lips were slowly turning purple.
{f:I reached out,|What on earth was} {f:trying to grab Hosoda.|happening to him?}
{f:At that moment, I clearly felt my hand|When I reached out without thinking, my hand} touch{f:|ed} 'something' in the empty air at his neck.
rows.22:b0b4:

Hosoda suddenly started coughing, then took deep, heaving breaths.
rows.22:b140:

Still looking down, Hosoda muttered.{p}
rows.22:b37c:
"In that restroom stall, the traces of the blood are still there.
{f:Go and see for yourselves|It's true}.
{f:Then you'll know my story is true|It's pretty well known among the boys}.{p}But be careful.
